method: First15 groups of batch88:32 source-specific first-frame comparisons. FAKEPBOC and PBOCPEPE full images enlarged (both static). Three long-name candidates fetched to short local filenames and inspected after Windows path-length preview failure; CDN media was available. No exhaustive animation claim.

priority_change.policy: Exact original components first, whole retained stems after edge-marker substitutions next, long boundary stems next, internal substrings last. Existing lane quotas, volume/buyer ordering within quality and source caps retained. Nothing removed from full queue. This is a heuristic, not a measured precision improvement.
